question: Does any full archived LP2-00–55 stream begin with the first 12 decoded warning runes under a fixed shift or reversed alphabet, with optional whole-stream reversal?
selection: All recognized runes including headings; remove other characters; no corrections. Prefix at position zero only.
criterion: Exact equality of the first 12 output indices with the fixed reference prefix.
stopping_rule: Complete all 56 × 2 × 2 × 29 = 6496 cases. No early stopping.
interpretation: A match is a candidate only, not evidence that the full page is solved. No match excludes only this exact opening under these conventions.
